title: ️ Rebellion, Secrets, and Crystals: Season 2 Of Andor Sticks the Landing In the Conclusion To the Series
content:
The final three episodes of the critically acclaimed and fan favorite show Andor have dropped and MeFites are chiming in with their thoughts:

Episode 10: "Make It Stop" The ISB closes in. Luthen scrambles. Kleya delivers. It's less pew-pew, more creeping dread—and it works brilliantly.

:emoji: Episode 11: "Who Else Knows" Secrets are currency, and everyone's cashing out, whether they want to or not. MeFi commenters highlight the show's espionage vibes and quietly devastating performances.

Episode 12: "Jedha, Kyber, Erso" More of an epilogue as as everyone assesses their status after the last two episode. The MetaFilter crowd dives into theories, connections to Rogue One, and why Andor is the most grown-up Star Wars has ever been.
author: Brandon Blatcher
